scored.name: Microchip-ready pet ID tag and registration kit
scored.moat_mechanism: None: engraved stock blanks, brand only
scored.reasoning: EU microchip/registration regulation adopted Apr 2026 (lovguiden.dk, agenceurope.eu links in record) but phase-in date unverified and no evidence it lifts tag demand. Tags are cheap, engraved-blank commodity at EUR 15-24; paid CAC exceeds contribution and no founder B2B channel (vets/shelters are not founder networks). Only viable as an add-on to a hero product.

scored.name: Passive greenhouse and cold-frame vent opener
scored.moat_mechanism: None registrable; VELUX-style window adapters and lift-force chart are engineering/content, not IP (design registration weak)
scored.reasoning: Incumbent Bayliss/Univent exist: twowests.co.uk lists Bayliss MK7 at GBP 39.99 and Super MK7 at GBP 99.99; charleysgreenhouses lists Univent at USD 56 (sources conflict on lift 5.5-7 kg). So a EUR 39-49 price is credible, giving ~4-5x landed on EUR 6-9, but the product is a stock wax cylinder anyone can source. Small Nordic allotment market; garden-centre/building-supplier channel possible via founder contacts but unverified. Not killed.

Starter EUR 22 sits below EUR 35; repeat helps but CAC in beauty is high.

scored.name: Refillable family-planner whiteboard marker system
scored.moat_mechanism: Proprietary cartridge/refill format with design registration (real lock-in only if format is own; needs tooling)
scored.reasoning: Incumbents already sell refill systems: Pilot BeGreen V-Board Master cartridges (galaxus.de/.nl listings seen) and Edding BTK-25 25 ml bottle ~EUR 10.99 (aio.lv, price unverified date). A proprietary cartridge could lock in refills (EUR 9 refill at ~1.5-2.5 landed) but needs custom cap/cartridge tooling (record: keep under EUR 2k) and alcohol ink triggers CLP/flammability handling. Starter EUR 24 below EUR 35, repeat demand for home planners modest; cluster ids I219/I277 add nothing verified.

scored.name: Repairable desk tool set with spare-parts kit

Right to Repair directive does not cover desk tools (record), so this is positioning only. Desk stationery category dominated by Leitz/Rapid and Muji-style design.

scored.name: Home maintenance spare kit for windows
scored.moat_mechanism: B2B/professional channel the founders already have (ex-VELUX installers, housing associations, building merchants); fit guide per window type; optional exclusive seal-profile supplier
scored.reasoning: Best fit to founder edges. OEM competitor exists: VELUX ZZZ 220K service kit sells at GBP 37-48 (veluxblindsdirect.co.uk, emmetistore.uk, contents: foam, filter, tape, hinge grease; one kit per 2-5 windows), so a brand-agnostic or multi-brand kit for standard windows, plus seals, is a gap, not verified. Price EUR 29-39 with EPDM/stock profiles at EUR 7-11 landed (ASSUMPTION). Seals wear on cycle, supporting repeat via housing-association maintenance programmes. Risks: VELUX trademark/confidentiality limits on ex-employees, demand unverified (record says verify before committing). Channel via installers/merchants is credible low-CAC but still hypothesis.

scored.name: Appliance care refill kit (robot/stick vacuum consumables, dock descaler, brush heads, seasonal box)
scored.moat_mechanism: Weak: own descaler formulation + curated fit database; Nilfisk-style sourcing contacts for OEM-grade filters/brushes; no lock-in on others' hardware
scored.reasoning: Strongest repeat profile in this batch. Euronews/BEUC: vacuum battery EUR 281 shows pricey OEM parts (link in record). Roborock forum answer says no official descaling programme exists (forum.roborock.com seen), but OEMs sell floor solution at ~EUR 22/L (aio.lv) and third-party compatible parts flood Amazon, so moat is weak. Subscription/kit price EUR 19-49 with repeat absorbs CAC better than one-off items; descaler is CLP chemical needing co-packer and dock-material compatibility testing. Founders' robotics sourcing is a real edge for filters/brushes.
